claims.hypothesis: Does turbulence shape the gas structure and is there a scale where gravity dominates?
claims.experiment: Fractal dimension and power spectrum of dust continuum
claims.result: Dp~1.6, Df~1.8; power spectrum break at ~0.09 pc, near Jeans length 0.10 pc
claims.finding: Highly fragmented, compressively turbulent structure; gravity overcomes thermal pressure below ~0.1 pc

evidence.quote: We find a clear break in the turbulent power spectra derived from the optically thin dust continuum emission at a spatial scale of $\sim$ 0.1 pc.

claims.hypothesis: Is the initial gas structure smooth and centrally condensed like an Arches-like cluster?
claims.result: Only ~6e3 Msun within 0.5 pc; no central concentration
claims.finding: Gas is hierarchical; cluster must become centrally condensed dynamically; smooth-initial-gas models ruled out

evidence.quote: this is insufficient to form an Arches-like cluster by more than 2 orders of magnitude.

claims.hypothesis: Which molecules trace dust column density?
claims.result: High-excitation molecules (e.g. NH2CHO) best correlate with dust
claims.finding: Denser interior; molecular families trace similar material

evidence.quote: is most correlated with the morphology of the emission from the molecules with high excitation energies (NH$_{2}$CHO  in particular)
